description: Store a sign-in account the tester can use. The password is encrypted, never returned, and never sent to the tester's AI: the tester types it. Tests refer to the account by name ("Sign in as the account \"customer\""). Through MCP the password passes through your AI agent: prefer adding passwords in the web app or over the REST API from a secret store. Reference: https://testsy.dev/docs/mcp/

name.description: Name tests use, for example customer (up to 60 characters)

name: add_credential
title: Add a sign-in account
